description: This file defines a final utility class 'MyExecutors' that provides executor services for background and main thread execution in an Android environment. It includes methods to access a single-threaded executor with listening capabilities and an executor that posts runnables to the main thread, facilitating asynchronous task handling within the app.

classes.name: MyExecutors
classes.description: A utility class providing executors for background and main thread operations in Android.

methods.name: bg
methods.description: Returns a singleton listening decorator executor service for background tasks.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Returns an executor that posts runnables to the main thread.
